snippet.description:
What makes a good UPSC Mains answer sheet? Is it about writing a few exceptional answers or maintaining consistent quality throughout the paper?

In this video, Karandeep Singh Sir explains why completing the paper with reasonably good content and consistent presentation can make your UPSC Mains copy stand out. Instead of spending too much time perfecting a few answers, focus on maintaining an acceptable standard across all answers and completing the paper within the given time.

The key lesson: Consistency, completion and presentation matter in UPSC Mains answer writing.

Watch this short for practical UPSC Mains preparation and answer-writing advice.
